name: Tallow
summary: Tallow is a Forsaken warrior stationed in the fortified settlement of Tarren Mill within the Hillsbrad Foothills. Serving the Dark Lady and the Horde, he watches over the contested front lines, helping organize strikes against local Alliance threats.

sections.title: A Blade in Tarren Mill
sections.body: Situated in the heart of Tarren Mill, Tallow stands among the Forsaken and Horde forces holding the line in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The region is a powder keg of conflict, caught between nearby Southshore humans, wandering Syndicate outlaws, and hostile wildlife. Tallow helps direct capable adventurers into the field, testing their strength against the Boulderfist ogres of the Arathi Highlands before sending them on to aid the besieged outpost of Hammerfall.

faq.answer: Tallow is a Forsaken warrior based in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, acting as an organizer and quest giver for Horde champions fighting in the area.
He can be found standing in the Forsaken-held town of Tarren Mill, located in the northern half of the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Tallow is known for directing Horde adventurers in the mission 'The Hammer May Fall', sending fighters to prove themselves against the Boulderfist ogres of the Arathi Highlands before reporting to Drum Fel at the besieged Hammerfall outpost.

faq.q: What is Tarren Mill's role in the conflict?
faq.answer: Tarren Mill serves as the primary northern Horde stronghold in the Hillsbrad Foothills, facing constant skirmishes and open warfare against the human bastion of Southshore to the south.

angles.text: Tallow provides essential frontline tasks for Horde champions looking to weaken the human presence throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Like many Forsaken in Tarren Mill, Tallow fights to expand Undercity's dominion south of the Alterac Mountains.
